Server rules of season 5
Section A: Basic Rules of Common Sense 1.0: Don't be unfriendly to others, in other words, don't be a dick. 1.1: Use common sense, if something would piss you off. Probably you doing this to another person would also piss them off. So just don't do it. 1.2: Abusive words are not tolerated on the server, as also not tolerated on this servers discord. 1.3: We already have our own cave troll "Tramponia", so we don't accept other trolls on this server. Trolling will result in a kick / ban or other measure that we see fit. 1.4: No use of alts because they can be used to gain a unfair advantage. This also includes two or more players sharing anything to advance their group beyond what a single player can achieve.
Section B: Basic rules of slow paced 2.0: Because we aim to this being a slow and easy server. There is no need to rush progression, so, when you discover you are online way more that others. Try to put this online overtime in doing things that everyone can enjoy Examples: "Built roads, bridges, parks, and farms. fill in the shortages the economy currently is lacking (if you can), upgrade your house, town or country so it looks beautiful." 2.1: Things that are built publicly that are too all players use (roads, docks) are to be left untouched. 2.2: We don't like floating buildings on this server. So try to keep buildings physics somewhat realistic. 2.3: Try to keep the landscape intact, so, no large craters, no huge fields of debris etc. 2.4: Vertical farming is NOT allowed. If your think you have a lack of space for farming, contact a town for farming districts / plots, or buy more plots from the federation. (bewerkt)donderdag 31 juli 2025 11:30
Section C: Economic rules and guidlines 3.0: Nothing is for free in the real world. The same principle applies here, nothing is to be "given" to other players, and everything has a price. So use the shop, and let the currency roll! 3.1: Keep your stores stocked at all times, A good functioning economy relies on the fact that your shop has buy and sell orders in your shop. This ensures that the economy soldiers on, even when you are not online. 3.2: Pay your transporters, when putting up buy orders, take into consideration that people must travel to you to bring you the desired product. So in order for people to make money, you should add a small fee. For example, i want product A and market sell price is 1 "coin", a fair buy order would be 1,1 Coin or 1.2 coin a piece. This way, transporters can buy product A at store X and sell them at your store, for a small profit. Sparing you precious game traveling time. 3.3: What is considered stealing? Since the game is very focused on plots and districts be sure to plant your farms within these zone's. Plants placed outside these plots are not considered stolen if someone takes them. 3.4: Please make use of the calculator. 3.5: Playing with friends or groups is allowed, as long as you don't start "teaming" otherwise know as: Harmful grouping. (Meaning, keep everything within your own group, open stockpiles, no shops). Off course you can play with friends, but be sure you pay each other for each others services. And don't be afraid to buy something from "strangers". 3.6: It is not allowed to outbuy fellow players, and reselling the same product at the same of higher price in your own store, this effectively could create a monopoly, and we wont allow it. 3.7: Store carts, are allowed on the server, but should never be placed on public roads (if placed in a town, consult the mayor). Some towns might have rules/permits regarding shopping carts. Violation of the rules will result in an admin deleting your carts
Section D: Settlement rules 4.0: Settlements may not seize property or funds from players not in the official abandoned demographic. This prevents abuse of players and/or funds. 4.1: Settlements may not monopolize on a certain good using their influence in such a way that it will damage a economy. Blocking off, or taxing a certain good within their influence are some examples of this. (Too high is subjective, and thus will be judged by an admin).
